create_perceptron_classifier: create a Perceptron classifier with default parameters for binary or multiclass classification
train_perceptron_model: train a Perceptron classifier on labeled data using fit with tol and random_state parameters
evaluate_perceptron_predictions: evaluate a trained Perceptron model on test data using score for accuracy measurement
configure_perceptron_regularization: configure a Perceptron classifier with l1, l2, or elasticnet penalty and alpha regularization strength
enable_perceptron_early_stopping: enable early stopping on a Perceptron classifier with validation_fraction and n_iter_no_change parameters
